# e2b_sandboxes (Data Source)

Lists E2B sandboxes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_sandboxes" "running" {
  states = ["running"]
  limit  = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of sandboxes to return. E2B treats `0` as no explicit limit.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Optional metadata filter.
- `states` (Set of String) Optional sandbox state filters, such as `running` or `paused`.

### Read-Only

- `sandboxes` (Attributes List) Matching sandboxes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sandboxes))

<a id="nestedatt--sandboxes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sandboxes`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) Template alias used to create the sandbox.
- `client_id` (String) E2B client ID for the sandbox.
- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPU cores allocated to the sandbox.
- `disk_size_mb` (Number) Disk allocated to the sandbox, in MB.
- `end_at` (String) Timestamp when the sandbox will expire.
- `envd_version` (String) Version of envd running in the sandbox.
- `id` (String) Sandbox ID.
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory allocated to the sandbox, in MB.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Sandbox metadata.
- `started_at` (String) Timestamp when the sandbox started.
- `state` (String) Sandbox state.
- `template_id` (String) Template ID used to create the sandbox.
- `volume_mounts` (Attributes List) Volumes mounted into the sandbox. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sandboxes--volume_mounts))

<a id="nestedatt--sandboxes--volume_mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sandboxes.volume_mounts`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) E2B volume name.
- `path` (String) Path where the volume is mounted in the sandbox.
